node.statement: Since dim S_Q=1, S_Q is nonzero, so the registered delta-projection dichotomy makes Q nonvanishing for universal small e and gives ||Q||=1+O(delta). Therefore w(lambda)=lambda Q is linear and star-preserving, has product defect ||w(lambda mu)-w(lambda)w(mu)||=|lambda mu|*||Q-Q^2||<=delta|lambda||mu|, and has two-sided (1+O(delta)) norm bounds. Hence w is a sufficiently accurate non-unital c_Q*e-inclusion, uniformly, and w(1)=Q.
